title: How to Connect Multiple Wallets from Different Providers to One Dashboard
content_html:
How to Connect Multiple Wallets from Different Providers to One Dashboard

You can connect wallets from any provider (MetaMask, Ledger, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect-compatible apps, and more) to a single Cryptool dashboard. By adding each wallet’s public address, Cryptool aggregates balances, positions, and rewards across all chains, giving you a unified, non-custodial view of your entire portfolio.

Why multi-wallet management matters

Most portfolio trackers let you monitor only one wallet or one blockchain at a time. When you hold assets on Ethereum, stake on MultiversX, and trade on BNB Chain, you end up juggling separate apps or spreadsheets that quickly become outdated. A multi-wallet dashboard pulls every address into one view, showing total value, unrealised profit and loss, fee exposure, and vesting schedules without manual entry or custody transfer.

How to set it up

1. Create an account at cryptool.io or app.cryptool.io. Sign up with email or connect a wallet directly.
2. Open your profile and go to the Wallets tab. Click Add Wallet.
3. Paste the public address for each wallet you want to track. You can add addresses from MetaMask, Ledger, Trust Wallet, WalletConnect-compatible apps, or any other provider.
4. Repeat for every blockchain you use. Cryptool supports portfolio tracking on all major chains; on-chain modules currently run on EVM chains and MultiversX, with more coming soon.
5. Once added, the dashboard aggregates balances automatically. Switch between individual wallets or view the combined portfolio at any time.

What you get after connecting

  • A single portfolio view across every wallet and chain
  • Automatic balance updates at regular intervals
  • Vesting and allocation tracking alongside liquid assets
  • Visibility of staking rewards without opening each protocol
  • The ability to log in with any connected wallet

If you run a fund or syndicate, the same wallet connections feed into group pools, raise management, and investor reporting. The portfolio layer serves as the foundation for advanced features.

FAQ

Can I add wallets from different providers at the same time?

Yes. You can connect MetaMask, a Ledger hardware wallet, a Trust Wallet address, and any other supported provider within the same Cryptool account. Each wallet appears in your Personal Wallets list.

Do I need to move funds to Cryptool?

No. Cryptool is non-custodial. The platform reads on-chain data through read-only connections, so your assets remain in your own wallets.

How many wallets can I add?

The Free plan provides basic wallet support, while Premium, Premium+, Business, and Enterprise plans raise the limits and add extra features. Refer to the pricing page for the exact limits of each tier.

What chains are supported?

Portfolio tracking works on all major blockchains. On-chain modules such as Raise, Market, and Groups currently operate on EVM-compatible chains and MultiversX, with additional networks in development.

Can I use this for a fund or syndicate?

Yes. Once your wallets are connected, you can create a group under the Business or Enterprise plan. Group members add their own wallets, and the combined portfolio rolls up automatically. See our guide on running a non-custodial crypto syndicate for more details.

Start seeing the full picture

Connect your first wallet in under five minutes: no credit card required. Try Cryptool’s Free tier today and discover the complete view of your crypto holdings.
